question: Can even the five-faced one fully describe this teaching to the supreme goddess?
premises: The five-faced one is invoked as speaker or agent
Describing the teaching is the task
inference: Even with five faces one is not able to describe it fully.
uncertainties: pañca+vaktraiḥ may refer to Śiva's five mouths as instruments of speech.
plain_english: Even with five faces one is not able to describe it, O supreme goddess.
